name: Takamine Riku
source:
A 3rd year student belonging to "The Roses in Full Bloom" class.

The noble son of the Takamine Zaibatsu. Since he's particularly distinguished, Riku is called "Aka Bara-sama" ("Lord Red Rose"). He's haughty and unskilled in relaying his true feelings. Having extreme pride in himself, he's an authoritarian that takes lineages and forms of address very seriously. Due to this, his propensity to speak to others like he believes they're fools stands out. When it comes to people he takes a liking to, an inept side of him shows as he's overly aggressive towards them.

[Taken from [URL=http://otome-jikan.net/2014/04/28/zettai-kaikyuu-gakuen-eden-with-roses-and-phantasm/]Otome Jikan[/URL].]
